items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Billy Rose really loved music, and he surrounded himself with some of the best music that you could have at that time. All put together, it didn't mesh or blend as a show, but he did have -- he presented Benny Goodman and one show, Benny Goodman, Igor Stravinsky, and William Shuman and Cole Porter.

ctx.x: William Shuman who was then on the way to becoming the new young President of Juilliard, and now he's President of Lincoln Center.

And the chorale, the music, the popular music of the show was composed by Cole Porter, the chorale was under the conduction of Shaw, that famous choral conductor -- Bob Shaw I guess his name is. And he conducted the chorus in a gorgeous arrangement of 'Every Time We Say Goodbye,' acapella thing. So the show -- and Goodman's Quintet playing jazz.
